title: Prove recursive native word-width margins (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove that #2899's actual minimal root templates remain sufficient through the historical #2809 dimension-64 recursive caller. For n0>=64 and M=q^w, widths bitlength(n0)+1 and bitlength(M)+1 cover the two native working banks and matching ingress at every admitted finite prefix, before unrelated failure. Every fixed-word divisor has its high-zero margin.

The new source-bound implication covers complete original-gap geometry, child histories, one-past endpoints, the terminal route mask and parent restoration. It inherits #2449's local arithmetic. The route mask may exceed M and is bounded separately. This complements the [capacity proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/0ca312ed12585a1dc56bcb3d90354f8c6307dc28/research/recursive-physical-capacity-prefix). **No new κ.**

## Evidence

Base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. SOURCES.json pins 22 executed files and two provenance records; INVENTORY.json binds 31 numerical modules and 19 fixed-word division sites.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/recursive-native-word-margins
```

Expected: `PASS_RECURSIVE_NATIVE_WORD_MARGINS`, normally and with optimization on Python 3.12. Both passed, as did committed-byte/mode checks. Evidence includes 303,861 symbolic affine certificates, 33 actual geometry cases, 19 complete projected-gap executions, nine authentic selected records, reduced complete high routes and restored numerical banks.

Controls reject missing margin bits, high-bit divisors, terminal-mask shifts, overflow increments, gap-crossing chunks, altered source/affine inventories and seven stale import cohorts. Independent AI review derived the bounds separately and identified the active stream_runner/linear_sign inventory correction, now repaired and pinned.

## Scope and open next questions

Canonical residues, admitted source classes, valid chronological records, ownership and non-width semantics remain explicit; no completed successful reference run is assumed. Separate preparation rings, stock, termination, complete native endpoint and current #6030 admission remain outside this result; numerical capacity is addressed by the separate proof linked above. Finite evidence is not a full GL64 payload. Next: discharge one remaining actual native semantic implication and establish complete outer-caller compatibility.

## Credit

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI source/mathematical review, not human or proof-kernel acceptance. Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml and #2449, #2501, #2569, #2753, #2769, #2809, #2899, #2831 and #5191. Full proof, review pins, failed draft checks and limitations: [research package](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/f04a672856f8f7cf9fc290bbd55ee4a7a77a126b/research/recursive-native-word-margins).
